bio: Come and try for yourself Afternoon Tea at the delightful DoubleTree by Hilton Oxford Belfry. Set in 17 acres of stunning gardens and grounds, the Oxford Belfry is the perfect place to relax and enjoy a wonderful afternoon with family and friends.  A quintessentially British Afternoon Tea is served in the Rycote Lounge, including a selection of finger sandwiches and a daily changing sweet treat for your fancy.  DoubleTree by Hilton Oxford Belfry is just minutes from the M40 motorway, with the nearest railway station Haddenham & Thame Parkway; it is the perfect place to escape the city and bask in the beautiful countryside.
